pass_rule: recovered iff ALL: (a) architecture PF00017+PF07714 (SH2 before PK_Tyr_Ser-Thr) occurs in >=1 protein of Metazoa, in >=1 protein of a Choanoflagellata species, and in >=1 protein of a Filasterea species; (b) >=1 PF-HOG(PF00102) has present_at(P(Metazoa)) with >=1 member from Metazoa and >=1 member from a non-metazoan Filozoa species.

'Filozoa or earlier' operationalised as presence in Metazoa + Choanoflagellata + Filasterea (operational choice).

All three required.
notes: Per-transition result is reported separately; if a P node has no data of adequate quality (flagged low BUSCO in red algae) that transition is not_evaluable and the control is scored on the remaining two with the omission explained (operational choice).

pass_rule: recovered iff ALL: (a) >=1 PF-HOG(PF03514) has origin on stem(Zygnematophyceae+Embryophyta); (b) hit(PF03514) occurs in <=2 species of outside(Zygnematophyceae+Embryophyta); (c) the best DIAMOND hit (e<=1e-5, by bitscore) of >=1 representative per gained HOG, searched against all euk plus prokaryote-run proteomes with the clade itself excluded, lies in a bacterial proteome. If no bacterial or other outside hit passes e<=1e-5, (c) is not_evaluable and the control is scored on (a) and (b) with a flag.
notes: HGT positive control. Prokaryote proteomes from the prokaryote run (species_final_prok.tsv) serve as the bacterial database; limited bacterial sampling can make (c) not_evaluable.

notes: Co-option control (not a duplication prediction; evo_biology.md 5, H13).

pass_rule: recovered iff n(V. carteri f. nagariensis) >= 2 * n(C. reinhardtii) AND n(V. carteri) - n(C. reinhardtii) >= 5, where n = number of proteins with hit(PF12499) in the final proteome.
notes: Ratio 2 chosen above the 1.5-fold smallest effect of interest and the absolute difference of 5 are operational choices fixed before results. HMM NAME is DUF3707 (DESC 'Pherophorin'). Reviewer 3.7 also suggests anchoring a HOG on V. carteri regA (VARL; no Pfam model): reported descriptively, not scored, not an A1 row.

anchor_protein: Neurospora crassa Hex1 (Woronin body protein; eIF5A paralog)
pass_rule: Let H_hex be the HOG containing N. crassa Hex1, identified by reciprocal best DIAMOND hit to the published Hex1 sequence (fallback: Aspergillus nidulans HexA). recovered iff EITHER (i) H_hex is not the HOG containing N. crassa eIF5A, origin(H_hex)=crown(Pezizomycotina), and >=90% of its member species are Pezizomycotina (<=2 outside species); OR (ii) H_hex contains N. crassa eIF5A, has >=1 duplication on stem(Pezizomycotina), median member count per Pezizomycotina species >=2 and median per Taphrinomycotina species <=1.
notes: UniProt accession left blank (unknown to the pre-registrant; resolve from the N. crassa proteome by reciprocal best hit). Two branches because Ancestra may keep eIF5A and Hex1 in one HOG (duplication) or split them (gain). expected_event 'duplication+gain' follows reviewer wording 'duplication/gain'.

pass_rule: recovered iff BOTH: (a) median per-species n(hit(PF01185)) in sampled Agaricomycetes >= max(3, 2 * median per-species n in sampled non-Agaricomycetes Dikarya); (b) n(hit(PF01185)) = 0 in every sampled Saccharomycotina species (leak tolerance applies: at most 1 species with hits).
notes: Class I only (PF01185); class II hydrophobin (PF06766) not included. The numeric thresholds (3, 2x) are operational choices fixed before results.

pass_rule: recovered iff, for each of the three toolkit classes (kinase_ptyr, adhesion_ecm, signalling; data/toolkit_pfam.tsv, members only), the H5/H6-style statistic on the fungal hyphae stem (share of stem duplications falling in class HOGs) is NOT called an expansion; an expansion is called iff empirical upper-tail percentile >=0.95 against the matched control branches (DESIGN 4.1) AND observed/expected >=1.5.
notes: Expected-null control. With three classes, a false failure is possible under the null (about 14% at percentile 0.95 alone); the added 1.5-fold requirement mitigates this. Operational choice.

pass_rule: recovered iff median per-species n(proteins with architecture PF00109+PF00698) in sampled Dictyostelia >= 10 AND >= 2 * median per-species n in sampled non-Dictyostelia Amoebozoa (genome-based species only; all if fewer than 2).
notes: Replaces v1 'kinase expansion in Dictyostelia' (no transition-specific support). Thresholds 10 and 2x are operational choices fixed before results; transcriptome-only comparators undercount and are excluded as stated.

pass_rule: Cyanobacterial groups from data/species_final_prok.tsv: filamentous = lineage_group Bacteria-Cyanobacteria-* with role 'multicellular'; heterocystous = the subset whose transition_id contains T_cyano_heterocyst; unicellular = Bacteria-Cyanobacteria-* with role closest_unicellular_sister or outgroup AND multicellularity_type 'none'. A Pfam passes iff its fraction of species with hit(X) is >=0.8 in the test group and <=0.2 in the unicellular group (test group: filamentous for PF18460 and PF24301; heterocystous for PF28069). recovered iff >=2 of the 3 Pfams pass.
